title: Microsoft Teams: manage built-in Teams agents from a dedicated admin centre page
summary: The admin paths and roadmap details are supported, but the briefing overstates what restricting agent availability protects. Users who cannot interact with Channel Agent can still see its messages, and unlicensed users can see Facilitator output, contrary to the cost rationale's assumption about everyone who sees the agents.

claims.claim: The prepare action rating fits a launched, default-on change rated medium risk that requires an availability decision.
